test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A 252 m long train is running at a speed of 125 km/h. What is the time (in seconds) in which it will pass a man who starts from the engine running at the speed of 17 km/h in the same direction as that of the train?
solution:
**Given:**

The length of the train = 252 m

The speed of the train = 125 km/h

The speed of the man = 17 km/h

**Concept:**

The relative speed of two objects that are moving toward the same direction = (Speed of the first object) - (The speed of the second object)

**Formula used:**

{Speed}={Distanceover Time}

**Calculation:**

According to the question

The length of the train = 252 m

The relative speed = 125 - 17 = 108 km/h = 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s

The time taken by train to pass the man 

⇒ 252/30 sec

⇒ 8.4 sec

**∴ The required result will be 8.4 seconds.**
